Arosa Bella Review

Review of Arosa Bella

A-Rosa Bella cruises on the Danube River, departing from ports in Austria and Germany. Her sisterships include the fleetmates Mia, Riva, and Donna.

Cabins

A-Rosa Bella has a total of 100 cabins (48 with French Balconies, 6 with Panoramic Windows, and 46 with non-opening windows), spread across 4 categories. Staterooms feature Juliet or panoramic balconies. Inside, guests will find simple yet elegant furnishings, air conditioning, and television. The highest cabin category is the French Balcony. There are no Suites on this ship.

Shipboard Facilities

Onboard wellness amenities include a bio sauna, Finnish sauna, and a relaxation area—offering ample space for rest and rejuvenation. The Sun Deck features an outdoor pool, shaded lounging area, giant chess, shuffleboard, and a putting green.

Dining and lounge venues include the Market Restaurant (main dining), Café Bar (casual with Afternoon Tea), Bella Lounge & Bar (featuring regional specialties), the Sun Deck’s Mobile Bar & Grill, and the Bella Atrium.

A-Rosa Bella’s cruise fares are all-inclusive, covering Wi-Fi, guided shore excursions (including bicycle tours), ground transfers, onboard entertainment (live performances, lectures, tastings), 24-hour coffee/tea service, alcoholic beverages (beer, wine, spirits), and bottled water (replenished daily).

Prices are per person based on double occupancy and are indicative only. Final rates may vary depending on travel agency promotions, special offers, discounts, group bookings, or last-minute deals.

River Cruise Itineraries

  • "DANUBE CLASSICS" – 7-day round-trip from Vienna, with stops in Esztergom, Budapest (overnight), Bratislava, Krems, Melk, and Passau.
  • "THE DANUBE" – 7-day round-trip from Passau (via Munich), visiting Melk, Wachau Valley, Esztergom, Budapest (overnight), Bratislava, Vienna, and Durnstein.
  • "DANUBE CITY WELLNESS" – 4-day cruise from Munich (Passau round-trip), visiting Vienna (overnight) and Linz.
  • 7-day "Danube New Year's Cruise" from Passau, calling at Melk, Budapest, Bratislava, Vienna, Durnstein, and Linz.
  • 4-day "Danube Christmas Markets Cruise" round-trip from Passau, visiting Christmas markets in Passau, Vienna (overnight), and Linz.
  • 4-day "Danube Christmas Cruise" calling at Durnstein, Vienna, and Melk.

A-Rosa Bella’s itinerary program includes the following voyages from Germany and Austria:

  • 4-day round-trip from Passau to Wachau Valley, Vienna (overnight), Linz, returning to Passau
  • 4-day round-trip from Passau to Vienna (overnight), Linz, returning to Passau
  • 4-day round-trip from Engelhartszell to Wachau Valley, Vienna (overnight), Linz, returning to Engelhartszell
  • 4-day round-trip from Engelhartszell to Durnstein, Wachau Valley cruising, Vienna (overnight), returning to Engelhartszell
  • 5-day round-trip from Passau to Vienna, Budapest, Bratislava, Krems, Melk, returning to Passau
  • 5-day round-trip from Engelhartszell to Vienna, Budapest, Bratislava, Krems, Wachau Valley cruising, Melk, returning to Engelhartszell
  • 7-day round-trip from Engelhartszell to Vienna (overnight), Esztergom, Budapest (overnight), Bratislava, Krems, Wachau Valley cruising, Melk, returning to Engelhartszell
  • 7-day round-trip from Passau to Vienna (overnight), Esztergom, Budapest (overnight), Bratislava, Krems, Melk, returning to Passau
  • 7-day round-trip from Passau to Vienna (overnight), Esztergom, Budapest (overnight), Bratislava, Krems, Wachau Valley cruising, Melk, returning to Passau
  • 7-day round-trip from Engelhartszell to Wachau Valley, Budapest, Bratislava, Vienna (overnight), Durnstein, Linz, returning to Engelhartszell
  • 7-day round-trip from Vienna (overnight) to Esztergom, Budapest (overnight), Bratislava, Krems, Wachau Valley cruising, Melk, Passau, returning to Vienna

River Cruise Itinerary Ports

Below is a list of the countries and ports visited by A-Rosa Bella:

  • Germany – Passau, Linz
  • Austria – Vienna, Melk, Krems, Durnstein, Engelhartszell, Wachau Valley
  • Hungary – Budapest, Esztergom
  • Slovakia – Bratislava

Shore excursions offered by A-Rosa Bella are typically themed around food and wine, cultural and historical sightseeing (including museums, architecture, and old town tours), as well as sports and leisure activities.

Arosa Bella Wiki

A-Rosa Bella cruises on the Danube River and belongs to the same class as the A-ROSA ships Donna, Mia, and Riva. Each of these vessels is powered by two MTU/Maybach marine diesel engines (model "16V 2000 M60") with a combined output of 1600 kW / 2170 HP. The ship's electrical system includes three MAN diesel generators (model D2842, each producing 380 kW) and one emergency diesel generator (Deutz, output 37 kW). Propulsion is provided by two Schottel twin propellers (type "STP 550") and a Schottel Pump Jet (azimuth bow thruster, model "SPJ 57"). The wheelhouse and awnings can be lowered to pass under low bridges. A-Rosa Bella also offers complimentary bicycles for use during shore excursions in each port of call.

A-Rosa Bella was launched on May 9, 2002. Due to her 14.4-meter beam, the vessel could not be delivered via the standard route (North Sea-Baltic Canal-Wadden Sea-Rhine River). Because of the Main-Danube Canal’s width restriction of 11.4 meters, the ship was loaded onto pontoons and towed through the Black Sea to the Danube Delta (Constanta, Romania). She was then unloaded and sailed under her own power to Oltenita, Romania. The entire delivery process took 22 days.
